verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help center has a dedicated setup article for its Puzzle MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration. The integration connects a Puzzle account directly to Claude so an agent can access financial data conversationally, which is an official first-party MCP server. missing for 10: details on the exposed tools/scopes and read vs. write capability, auth/setup specifics, documented support for agents beyond Claude, independent or hands-on corroboration.
